stage: Day 14 synthetic prototype review and chronological split planning
timezone: Not specified by dataset source; timestamps kept timezone-naive.

prototype.policy: Choose and freeze chronological boundaries first, then regenerate synthetic events only inside the untouched evaluation region using predeclared seeds.

event_reviews.special_observation: Twenty-five-row causal ramp followed by an artificial return to the untouched trajectory.
Five-row persistent reduction followed by a recovery edge.
Radiation changes while power, voltage, and current retain their baseline values.
Short three-row step reduction; power and voltage use the same factor.
Creates three expected extra NaNs in safeguarded power relative change.
Synthetic value is above the maximum observed in the available baseline dataset; equipment capacity is unknown.
The seed-42 event selected Relative_Humidity; other original measurements remain unchanged.

definitions.direct: At least one original operational or sensor measurement was deliberately modified; synthetic_anomaly remains 1.
definitions.propagated: Original measurements are untouched, but one or more causal rolling/change features differ because of an earlier synthetic event.
definitions.none: Neither original measurements nor engineered features differ from the baseline.

proposed_future_field.name: synthetic_effect_context
proposed_future_field.precedence: direct takes precedence if both a measurement and derived context are affected

direct_vs_propagated_effects.evaluation_note: A detector using rolling/change features can alert on propagated rows even though the strict point label is 0. Keep primary point metrics against direct labels and report alerts in propagated context separately rather than relabeling them after seeing scores.

spike_review.neutral_result: above the maximum observed in the available baseline dataset.
spike_review.capacity_interpretation: Physical equipment capacity is unknown; no capacity claim is made.

near_zero_nan_review.core_model_recommendation: Keep power and solar relative-change/ratio features outside the first Core model. The established Core nine features contain none of these ratios.

advantages: Uses 600 normal-like rows for detector and scaler fitting.
Training spans daylight, night, and the following morning.
The evaluation region contains afternoon daylight, the second 17:00 transition, and night.
disadvantages: Calibration has only 90 rows (3 hours) and is entirely daylight.
A threshold calibrated only at midday may not transfer well to the low-light portion of evaluation.
The regions still come from one complete daily cycle plus partial boundaries.

advantages: Provides 336, 336, and 337 rows with daylight and low-light observations in every region.
Calibration covers pre-dawn, sunrise, morning, and midday rather than one narrow regime.
The evaluation region includes afternoon, the second recurring 17:00 transition, and night.
disadvantages: Only 336 rows remain for model fitting.
Training daylight is limited to the late-afternoon portion of April 27.
Adjacent regions from this short record are not independent daily samples.

recommended_split.reason: All three regions contain daylight and low-light rows, and calibration covers more operating regimes than Option A. This is preferable for a prototype threshold review even though training has only 336 rows.
recommended_split.limitation: The regions are adjacent parts of approximately 33.6 hours with only one complete daily cycle; they are chronological but not independent days.
recommended_split.status: planning recommendation only; no split datasets created

future_model_data_policy: Use untouched baseline rows from the training region.
Reserve a separate untouched baseline calibration region.
Fit the scaler using training data only.
Train the unsupervised detector using training data only.
Select and freeze the alert threshold using calibration data only.
Regenerate synthetic copies using only the evaluation region and new predeclared seeds.
Evaluate the frozen pipeline against direct synthetic labels and report propagated-context alerts separately.
interpretation_limit: Synthetic events are controlled prototype cases, not verified photovoltaic faults, and no detector-performance result is produced in this stage.
